//: Copy to a machine-local worker.json (never commit it) and point FAMILIAR_WORKER_CONFIG at it.
//token: The Familiar credential is NOT configured here. Set FAMILIAR_RUNNER_TOKEN in the environment.
//capabilities: Roles this worker accepts. An approved step whose role no worker declares stays Started and blocks its task until you capture or cancel it.
//lease: Optional. The worker renews this bounded lease while the adapter runs; expiry recovers crashed work.
//projects: Machine-local repository mapping. Only these projects are ever offered to this worker.

projects.//mode: read-only, or edit-worktree to let approved Implementer sessions change files here. Even then only the Implementer writes; Planner and Reviewer stay read-only. edit-worktree needs a clean LINKED git worktree and refuses to start otherwise.
projects.//projectPath: Optional. The canonical checkout this worktree mirrors. When an assignment names an absolute path under it, the runner restates that path relative to the workspace so an Implementer and a Reviewer resolve the same file; without it such a path is flagged as unreachable instead of guessed at. It grants nothing — containment is still decided by allowedRoot.
